allocation: Explicit whole-experiment allocation; chronological valve blocks; overlap-connected recordings kept together. No model results used.
fitting_policy: Use normal-labeled rows from train plus the source-designated anomaly-free train recording; deduplicate timestamp and all eight sensors before fitting. Do not synthesize source annotations for the unlabeled file.
feature_policy: Only the eight sensor columns and causal derived features. Exclude annotation columns, recording IDs, and absolute timestamps. Reset window state between recordings.
selection_policy: Fit preprocessing and models on train only. Choose features, thresholds, hyperparameters, and alert aggregation on validation. Freeze all decisions before accessing test for evaluation.
test_policy: Metadata and overlap checks performed during inventory; no outcome exploration or modeling. Test use requires explicit opt-in. Do not tune or refit using test.
limitations: Single testbed; some train/validation/test recordings share a date and operating session. Not an unseen-machine, unseen-day, or official SKAB leaderboard split.
